outcome: comorbidity with chronic diseases (hypertension, diabetes mellitus, dyslipidemia)
cohort: The study included 17,177 pregnant women in the health region of Lleida, Spain, between 2012 and 2018.
finding: The prevalence of hypothyroidism in pregnant women was 6.5%, varied by region of origin (lowest in Sub-Saharan Africa, highest in Asia and Middle East), and was associated with age, diabetes mellitus, hypertension, and dyslipidemia, but not with Apgar score or newborn weight.
